cases.requirement: Every observer must see matching primary and index generations.
cases.mechanism: An observer at the checkpoint sees mixed generations. A crash preserves the mismatch, and later retry cannot undo the earlier invalid observation.

cases.requirement: Every observer must see matching primary and index generations; a pre-publication failure leaves the old generation valid.
cases.mechanism: A complete next snapshot is prepared before the model's atomic reference replacement. Readers see old or new coherent state.

cases.requirement: Two distinct accepted increments must increase the count by two.
cases.mechanism: Two prepared writers read zero and both assign one. Each prepared write is repeatable, but one increment is lost; an older writer can also erase later work.

cases.requirement: Two distinct accepted increments must increase the count by two; a rejected stale attempt is retried from a fresh read.
cases.mechanism: The modeled compare-and-replace rejects a stale version. The explicit retry uses a fresh observation and preserves both increments.

cases.requirement: Both hints are independent booleans; partial completion is allowed. The test caller retries a failed attempt before declaring both complete.
cases.mechanism: Intermediate states meet the contract, and a demonstrated retry completes both writes without a shared transaction.

cases.requirement: Replaying a delivery of the same visit must count that visit only once.
cases.mechanism: The modeled upsert conflict action increments on each call; the upsert label does not establish idempotency.
